Sandbox_GodSystem_EnableEquipmentSplash_: Independent sandbox toggle for the bound melee splash effect; enabled by default. On the first zombie hit of each swing, damage the nearest up to five other zombies within about two tiles on the same floor. Direct hits from that swing are excluded. Walls and doors do not block it. Each level adds 10%% of the weapon's average minimum/maximum base damage; hit-specific modifiers are not included. Disabling hides the enhancement entry and pauses the effect while preserving its level.

Sandbox_GodSystem_EnableUtilityGenerator: Master switch. When disabled, the device stops supplying water and power and new placement is hidden; owned devices and their balance remain.

When enabled, supply fixed objects with the vanilla piped-water interface only after public water is shut off. Cost is reserved per 100 L; unused prepaid water is refunded when stopped or picked up. Enabled by default.

When enabled, the native generator supplies power only after public electricity is shut off. Fuel is prepaid and billed by actual consumption; unused reserved fuel is refunded when stopped or picked up. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_GodSystem_UtilityGeneratorWaterP: Utility Generator Water Price per 100 L
System coins charged for each 100 L supplied after public water is shut off. Default: 20 coins. Price changes affect future refills only.
Sandbox_GodSystem_UtilityGeneratorElectr: Utility Generator Electricity Price per Fuel Unit
System coins charged for each vanilla generator fuel unit consumed after public electricity is shut off. Default: 5 coins. Price changes affect future fuel reserves only.
